FAQ

Your Questions Answered

A few useful things to know about my design practice and working together.

+

What kinds of products do you design?

I work on fintech, SaaS, marketplace and AI products, from requirements and user journeys through interface design, reusable components and implementation reviews.

+

What is your role in a project?

I map journeys, write requirements, explore design directions and create the screens and components developers need to build the product. The case studies explain my individual contribution and the limits of the outcome evidence.

+

Do you work with remote teams?

Yes. I’m based in Brighton, UK, and work with founders, product teams and developers remotely. Send the scope and timeline so I can discuss the scope and whether I’m the right fit.

+

Can I see your references and credentials?

Yes. The Credentials page contains recommendation letters, awards and course certificates, with the original documents available to read.

+

How can I get started?

Email aabdulfataijamiu@gmail.com with a short introduction, the product or opportunity, the problem you want to solve and your timeline. I’ll review the context and discuss next steps.
